rules.rule: Single-character live hook (layout=single) MUST give top priority to a rapid zoom-in (sudden_in:1.08) on the opening hook beat before any zoom-out.

In single-character live shots (layout=single), trigger a sudden zoom-in (sudden_in:1.08@<word_t>) on Supernova callouts or strong value points ([STRESS] vocal peak words), and pair follow-up beats with sudden_out:1.08 or smooth 1.0->1.06.

Place 1 to 2 crisp transitions (whip_left / whip_right) across raw clip boundaries inside a single-character hook or at Scene N boundaries; keep intra-clip and intra-scene splits as clean jump cuts (tr=cut, zero whoosh spam).
Two-character split screens (split_h / split_v) MUST stay 100% static (z=1.0 locked) with zero intra-split transitions (tr=cut) and zero whoosh.wav SFX between speaker turns.

In split_h (Left/Right) and split_v (Top/Bottom), both characters MUST share an identical common headroom (14%-20% matched head-crown gap) and matched face zoom scale, alternating active speaker and silent listening character (left <-> right or top <-> bottom).

Trim the actor's getting-ready stare before the first word and the freeze after the last: start 0.06-0.10 s before the first kept word and end 0.08-0.12 s after the last; the `speech` spans in facts.md show where speech really starts and stops.

For top_pip scenes (Subtopic 1.1 / 3.1), render a clean top-center rounded rectangle window (750x420 at x=165, y=20, radius=36px on 1080x1920, no phone status bar chrome) showing the AI Robot (R1..r4 or looping R extra.mp4 when listening) over the full-screen human background (M1, M2 or looping M extra.mp4 when listening).

When single-character clips (e.g. R1.mp4, M1.mp4, M2.mp4) contain multiple alternating dialogue turns separated by silent listening gaps, split them at each inter-turn silence midpoint to interleave with the partner's turns, and trim false-start head repeats (e.g. R2.mp4 0.00-1.02s).
